name: Pendle V2

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Both ProxyAdmins are real, distinct Safes (3-of-5 and 3-of-6), MarketFactoryV6’s owner is Pendle’s governance proxy whose DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the same 3-of-5 Safe, and no timelock gates any of the three.
narrative.tag: cross-exposure: 80 (pushed on-chain 2026-09-20), same Safe as Plasma Pendle
narrative.detail: ProxyAdmin.owner() and devProxyAdmin.owner() each resolve to a genuinely different, independently-composed Gnosis Safe. MarketFactoryV6.owner() is a 225-byte ERC-1967 proxy, Pendle’s governance proxy, with no owner() getter; read with hasRole on two RPCs on 2026-09-20, its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the same 3-of-5 Safe that owns ProxyAdmin (the same proxy address and the same admin Safe exist on Plasma), so this third path adds no weaker link and the score does not move. A separate GUARDIAN key can freeze markets (availability-only), disclosed by the 2026-09-20 sweep and not scored. Pushed on-chain 2026-09-20: the 3-of-5 Safe that owns ProxyAdmin is the same address, with the same 5 owners, that owns Pendle’s Router on Plasma, so crossExposureScore is folded to a flat 80 (composite unchanged). It is a dated, hand-confirmed flag on this target’s signer group, not a live comparison against Plasma.

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word

# the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0x544bf81c855ae84c1e8b65d5e38770898d01eee2","0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103","0x5aebe03"]}'
# owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<address from the slot>","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x5aebe03"]}'
# getThreshold() on the holder (a Safe)
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<holder>","data":"0xe75235b8"},"latest"]}'

# the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["<holder>","0x4a204f620c8c5ccdca3fd54d003badd85ba500436a431f0cbda4f558c93c34c8","latest"]}'
